summary: First-finish smoke test of VICHARO landing page. Backend (7 endpoint variations) and frontend (landing render, hero CTAs, HowItWorks tabs, mentor cards, FAQ, waitlist form submit + duplicate, mobile menu, Devanagari rendering) all passed via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL public URL.
passed: POST /api/waitlist role='admin' -> 400 'role must be mentee or mentor'
Navbar logo + Get Started button visible
Hero CTAs (find-mentor, become-mentor) visible; Become-a-mentor scrolls to waitlist form
4 mentor cards m1..m4 render; mentors-scroll-next works
Waitlist form: role toggles work, submit shows 'Welcome to VICHARO' toast; duplicate shows 'You're already on the VICHARO waitlist' toast (verified in screenshot)
Devanagari script विचार, आगे, आज renders correctly (verified visually)
Mobile viewport (390x844): mobile toggle visible and opens menu
action_items: Note: Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test/.example — this is expected library behavior, not a bug. Any docs/tests should use real-domain example emails (e.g., @example.com is accepted).
